replacements.zh: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。

before.literal: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading host to welcome Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu, general Xianyu Liang, and led Duan Liao and his division host back.
before.idiomatic: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.
before.en: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.

after.literal: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading a host to meet Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their Sima Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
after.idiomatic: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with a host to meet Duan Liao; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured Ma Qiu’s Sima Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
after.en: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with a host to meet Duan Liao; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured Ma Qiu’s Sima Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.

replacements.reason: Idiomatic (and the sealed en) omit 大敗之, the offices 司馬/將軍, and 及其部眾; that last omission drops Duan Liao’s followers from the return.

replacements.zh: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。

before.literal: Although Huang styled King of Yan, there was yet no court command; thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
before.idiomatic: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.
before.en: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.

after.literal: Although Huang styled himself King of Yan, there was yet no court mandate; he thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present the spoils of victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plains.
after.idiomatic: Though he called himself King of Yan, he still lacked a court mandate, so he sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present the spoils of victory at the capital, explain his provisional authority, and ask for a major campaign to pacify the Central Plains.
after.en: Though he called himself King of Yan, he still lacked a court mandate, so he sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present the spoils of victory at the capital, explain his provisional authority, and ask for a major campaign to pacify the Central Plains.

replacements.reason: Idiomatic/en omit 長史, weaken 獻捷京師 to “report victories”, and turn 討平中原 into a vague “northern expedition”.

replacements.zh: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。

before.literal: Ke rode victory to pursue them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand grades, built a fort at Fancheng and returned.
before.idiomatic: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.
before.en: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.

after.literal: Ke, riding the victory, pursued them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand heads, built a garrison at Fancheng and returned.
after.idiomatic: Murong Ke pressed the victory in pursuit, killed or captured over thirty thousand, built a garrison at Fancheng, and returned.
after.en: Murong Ke pressed the victory in pursuit, killed or captured over thirty thousand, built a garrison at Fancheng, and returned.

replacements.reason: Idiomatic/en omit 乘勝 and drop 餘 from 三萬餘級.
